issues.quote: Revenue rose 15.1% to $97.7 billion in fiscal 2024 from $96.8 billion in fiscal 2023.
issues.problem: Going from $96.8B to $97.7B is about 1% growth, not 15.1%. Tesla's FY2024 revenue rose roughly 1%.

data.summary: The figures are correct apart from the revenue growth rate. It is stated as 15.1%, but the actual increase is about 1%, which matches the dollar figures given and the "holding its top line" description.
